visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young girl with a black ponytail and bangs wearing a cream-colored shirt and green pants sits on a white bed. She holds a large yellow blanket patterned with white dots. The room is brightly lit, featuring white furniture and a light-colored wooden shelf in the background. (2) The girl pulls the yellow blanket over her head, her face showing focus and amusement as she tries to hide. Her hands are actively adjusting the fabric. (3) An adult hand wearing a black sleeve enters the frame from the right, lifting a corner of the blanket. The girl's face is partially revealed as she looks up toward the source of the hand. (4) A close-up shot shows the girl's small bare foot peeking out from under the floral yellow blanket. An adult hand reaches in and gently touches her toes. (5) The girl pushes the blanket down, emerging with a wide, joyful smile and squinted eyes, laughing at the interaction. (6) Standing up on the bed, she energetically pulls the blanket up again, wrapping it around her shoulders while looking excitedly at the camera. (7) The screen transitions to a pink background with a cartoon avatar of the girl and branding text.
